description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing anti-spam entries within the admin CMS module of an OpenCart-based application. It includes methods for listing, filtering, editing, saving, and deleting anti-spam keywords, along with setting up the necessary view data and handling user permissions.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Controller class for managing anti-spam keywords within the OpenCart admin panel, including list, add, edit, save, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main display of the anti-spam list page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of anti-spams for an AJAX request.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of anti-spam entries with pagination and filters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an anti-spam keyword.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of a new or edited anti-spam entry, with permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected anti-spam entries with permission verification.
